title: Greer contacted by a cosmic intelligence at 18

tellings.quote: but he does say at the age of 18 and he said this in his 2024 September event that he was contacted by like a cosmic intelligence um and told to basically save the world.

plain: Steven Greer, a well-known figure who holds public events about UFOs, says that at age 18 he was contacted by a kind of cosmic intelligence and told, in effect, to save the world, and he repeated this at his event in September 2024. A UFO researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb passes this along on Michels's show in 2025, as something Greer himself said in public. It is told as the root of Greer's sense of mission.
